metadata.Name: WINOGRANDE
metadata.Description: WINOGRANDE is a large-scale dataset of 44k problems inspired by the original WSC design, adjusted to improve both scale and hardness. It was created using crowdsourcing and a novel bias reduction algorithm.
metadata.Paper Title: WINOGRANDE: An Adversarial Winograd Schema Challenge at Scale
metadata.Abstract: The Winograd Schema Challenge (WSC), a benchmark for commonsense reasoning, is a set of 273 expert-crafted pronoun resolution problems originally designed to be unsolvable for statistical models that rely on selectional preferences or word associations. However, recent advances in neural language models have already reported around 90% accuracy on a variant of WSC. This raises an important question: Have neural language models successfully acquired commonsense or are we overestimating the true capabilities of machine commonsense? To investigate this question, we introduce WINOGRANDE, a large-scaledataset of 44k problems, inspired by the original WSC design, but adjusted to improve both the scale and the hardness of the dataset.
